title: Sarvestan Palace
axis: +X east and +Z south; the building’s rotated corners are recorded in plan controls.
identityStatus: Current four-corner outline for WHC component 1568-008 controls the footprint, with the mapped line length and angle kept. Archaeological sections and written dimensions distinguish the central iwan, domed rooms and arcades.

terrainContact.basis: Unchanged terrain at the centroid of the named Sasanian ruin.

notes: The 2011 public-domain Qualla original records the fractured entry crown, missing parts of the iwans and pitted brick dome. Text in Bier’s measured survey and subsequent excavations fixes room order and measured widths.
